summary: Phase D SEND fixes + Packers & Movers + SHOP icons tested on the Expo web preview (390x844) and backend pytest. Backend: 28 passed, 1 skipped (new test_mobile_send_movers.py has 10 tests, plus the phase_d regression with WS 4403/snapshot). UI: every requested flow passes. SEND details chips are in French (6 package chips, 3 preference chips). The searching track screen shows the title 'Recherche d’un livreur' with a different hint, 'Nous contactons les livreurs à proximité'. The 'Déménagement' tile (with image) opens /send/movers. Movers 6-step flow: the 'Étape n/6' label is correct. Size presets fill the inventory with correct counts (studio=11, 2 pièces=29, 4 pièces=54). Categories and items are in French. Counters work. Next buttons stay disabled until their step is valid. mv-back keeps the state. Floor, elevator and labour settings are sent correctly (stairs only when there is no elevator and floor>0). Slot cards are in French with the 'MEILLEUR PRIX' badge. Review fare 27 240 / 5 000 / 22 240 matches the POST /quote/movers response exactly. mv-book creates a confirmed movers booking (total equals the quote) and navigates to the track screen, which shows 'Déménagement confirmé', a timeline starting with that status, and the mv-summary card (date, slot, 2 objets · 160 kg, advance and remaining). Cancel moves the status to 'Annulée'. Single-drop SEND booking, cancel and the unauthenticated redirect back to /send/movers after login also work. SHOP: the home shows 12 distinct lucide icons. When images are blocked, the category grid shows 4/4 '-fallback' thumbs with the category icon, and the product page shows fallbacks too.

minor.issue: No bounds on labour_movers or floors: labour_movers=-5 with floors_pickup=-3 returns total=-14500, advance=5000, remaining=0. The booking endpoint uses the same quote, so a negative-total booking can be created. Add Field(ge=1, le=10) to labour_movers and Field(ge=0) to floors. Validate the floor in pickup_building/drop_building, which are untyped dicts.

These inputs are accepted silently: an empty items list; any move_type string (not checked against express_move_types); an unknown time_slot_code (surcharge becomes 0); an unparseable scheduled_date (stored as null). They should return 400/422.

issues: The 'Déménagement' tile label breaks in the middle of the word ('Déménagem' / 'ent') in the 4-column grid at 390px. Use a shorter label or adjustsFontSizeToFit/minimumFontScale, or allow hyphenation.

design_issues.screen: Track screen for a movers booking
issues: Parcel wording is still used for movers: header 'Suivi de livraison', timeline 'Livreur assigné / Colis récupéré / Livré', 'Total · Livraison', 'Annuler la livraison'. Use movers labels such as 'Déménageurs assignés', 'Chargement', 'Déménagement terminé', 'Annuler le déménagement'.
The 'all' category chip reads 'Tous les produits' (reused from the mart.all key). 'Tous' fits the context better.
Choosing a home size after editing quantities by hand silently replaces the manual inventory. The preset also applies to office and single_item move types.
mv-route-summary (km · min) never shows on web because computeRoute gives no distance. The review step does show the km from the quote. Minor, and possibly web-only.
The image fallback uses the generic ShoppingBag icon instead of the category icon (the category grid uses SHOP_ICONS). Minor inconsistency.

action_items: Backend: add Pydantic bounds to MoversQuoteIn and MoversBookingIn (labour_movers ge=1, floors ge=0). Type pickup_building and drop_building. Reject empty items, an unknown move_type and an unknown time_slot_code.
Mobile: fix the mid-word break in the 'Déménagement' tile label on the SEND module home.
Mobile: use movers-specific wording for the header, timeline, total and cancel on the movers track screen.
Mobile (optional): label the movers 'all' chip 'Tous'; ask for confirmation or merge when a size preset would overwrite manual quantities.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py movers booking: the quote is recomputed on the server with the slot surcharge from the database. This is correct and matches the client quote (verified). But a negative total is possible because inputs are not validated (see backend minor issues).

movers.tsx: the quote effect runs only on [step] changes. That is fine because inputs cannot change on the review step. If the quote fails, the Skeleton stays forever and there is no retry button. Add an error state with a retry.
movers.tsx is 218 lines and MoversParts is split out; the size is fine.
The movers booking timeline label 'Move booked' is English in the backend; the client maps it to French.
